ExternalTransactionRequest.description: Creates a transaction request. `SendCurrency` and `SendAccountId` are required. Supply either `SendValue` or `ReceiveValue`. Supply either `Recipient` or `StoredRecipient`.

SendAccountId.description: Identifies the account from which the payment is instructed.

SendAccount.description: The name of the account from which the payment is instructed.

SendCurrency.description: The currency used to fund the payment, in ISO 4217 currency code format.

SendValue.description: The amount to send in the specified `SendCurrency`. Supply either `SendValue` or `ReceiveValue`.

ReceiveValue.description: The amount the recipient should receive in the recipient currency. Supply either `ReceiveValue` or `SendValue`.

RequestedValueDate.description: The requested date on which the recipient should receive the payment, subject to processing and settlement times.

DateSearchMode.description: Optional search direction used with RequestedValueDate. Valid values are `Backward` and `Forward`.

RouteType.description: The payment route used to deliver the payment.

ExternalReference1.description: An optional custom reference used to store internal metadata, such as a policy number, claim ID, case reference, or reconciliation identifier.

ExternalReference2.description: An optional custom reference used to store internal metadata, such as a policy number, claim ID, case reference, or reconciliation identifier.

ExternalReference3.description: An optional custom reference used to store internal metadata, such as a policy number, claim ID, case reference, or reconciliation identifier.

CorrelationId.description: Identifies the transaction request within an external system.

Source.description: Identifies the source system that created the transaction request.

RateGroupId.description: Identifies the foreign exchange rate group used when calculating exchange rates.

ProgrammeId.description: Identifies the programme associated with the transaction request.

LatePaymentMode.description: Specifies how the transaction should be handled if payment cannot be completed on time.

Extra.description: Additional optional custom metadata used for reconciliation, tracking, reporting, or linking the transaction to internal systems.

ExternalAttachments.description: Supporting files attached to the transaction request.

FileIds.description: Identifies files attached to the transaction request.

ExternalDynamicRiskSharing.description: Dynamic risk sharing details for the transaction. Use either `MapKey` or `Splits`, but not both.

MapKey.description: Identifies the funding map configuration applied to the transaction.

Splits.description: The risk-sharing split configuration applied to the transaction.

ExternalECheque.description: Electronic cheque details for the transaction request.

ExternalOriginator.description: Details about the party on whose behalf the payment is made.

Country.description: The originator country, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code format.

ExternalPostalChequeRequest.description: Postal cheque details for the transaction request.

ExternalPostalRecipient.description: Postal recipient details for cheque delivery.

Country.description: The recipient country, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code format.

Currency.description: The recipient currency, in ISO 4217 currency code format.

ExternalStoredRecipientId.description: Identifies the stored recipient in an external system.

Nationality.description: The recipient nationality, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code format.

RecipientReference.description: The payment reference visible to the recipient.

ReferencePrefix.description: The prefix added to the recipient reference.

Type.description: The recipient type. Valid values are Person and Business.

ExternalStoredRecipient.description: Stored recipient details for the transaction request.

ExternalStoredRecipientId.description: Identifies the stored recipient in an external system.

PaymentPurpose.description: The reason for making the payment.

RecipientReference.description: The payment reference displayed to the recipient and typically included on their bank statement.

ExternalDynamicRiskSharingSplits.description: Risk-sharing configuration applied to the transaction.

Elements.description: The funding account allocations used to distribute the transaction amount across funding sources.

SplitType.description: Indicates whether split values are expressed as percentages or monetary amounts. Valid values are `Percentage` and `Amount`.

ExternalEChequeVerification.description: Verification details for the electronic cheque.

Type.description: The recipient verification method. Valid values are `Passphrase` and `SmsCode`.

Passphrase.description: The secret word or phrase the recipient must provide to access the electronic cheque. Required when `Type` is `Passphrase`.

ExternalPostalChequeDeliveryRequest.description: Delivery details for the postal cheque.

MailClass.description:
The postal service used to send the cheque.

| Value | Description |
| ---- | ------- |
| `Unspecified` | The delivery service is not specified. |
| `FirstClass` | USPS First Class delivery. Estimated delivery within 1–5 business days. |
| `Certified` | USPS Certified Mail with delivery confirmation and tracking. Estimated delivery within 1–5 business days. |
| `Express2Day` | Expedited delivery with tracking and estimated delivery within 2 business days. |
| `Overnight` | Overnight delivery with tracking and estimated next-business-day delivery. |

AbaCode.description: The nine-digit ABA routing number used to identify a US bank.

AccountNumber.description: The unique code assigned to a bank account, used for tracking funds and routing money to the correct destination.

BankAccountType.description: The bank account type, such as checking or savings. Supported values vary by country and payment route.

BankCity.description: The city where the recipient's bank is located.

BankCode.description: Identifies the bank within a domestic banking network.

BankGiro.description: The Swedish Bankgiro number used for domestic payments.

BankMfo.description: The MFO code used to identify banks in supported countries.

Bban.description: The Basic Bank Account Number (BBAN) used in supported countries.

BIK.description: The Bank Identifier Code (BIK) used to identify banks in Russia and other supported countries.

BinOrIin.description: The Business Identification Number (BIN) or Individual Identification Number (IIN), used in supported countries.

BranchAgencyCode.description: The branch or agency identifier used in supported countries.

BranchCode.description: Identifies a specific bank branch within a domestic banking network.

BsbCode.description: The Bank State Branch (BSB) code used to identify Australian bank branches.

Clabe.description: The 18-digit CLABE account identifier used for payments in Mexico.

ForeignId.description: The foreign identification number used when a national ID is not available.

Iban.description: The International Bank Account Number (IBAN) used to identify a bank account.

IdCardOrPassportNumber.description: The recipient's government-issued identity card or passport number.

IfscCode.description: The Indian Financial System Code (IFSC) used to identify an Indian bank branch.

KidReferenceNumber.description: The KID reference number used for supported Norwegian payments.

KnpOrUpdc.description: The taxpayer or payment identification used in supported countries.

KonstantSymbol.description: An additional payment classification code used in supported Czech and Slovak payment schemes.

NationalId.description: The recipient's government-issued national identification number.

NibCode.description: The National Bank Identifier (NIB) used in supported countries.

Nuban.description: The Nigerian Uniform Bank Account Number (NUBAN).

OcrReferenceNumber.description: The OCR reference number used for supported Swedish payments.

PaymentCode.description: The payment purpose or classification code required for certain payment routes.

PermanentCardToken.description: The permanent card token used to identify a stored card for card payout processing.

PlusGiro.description: The Swedish PlusGiro account number used for domestic payments.

Province.description: The province, state, or administrative region associated with the recipient or account.

RegistrationNumber.description: The recipient business or organisation registration number.

ResidenceNumber.description: The recipient residence number used for identification in supported countries.

RoutingNumber.description: The bank routing number used for domestic payments in supported countries.

SecurityAnswer.description: The answer to the security question used for secure payment delivery.

SecurityEmailAddress.description: The email address used to deliver the security question.

SecurityQuestion.description: The security question used to verify the recipient before payment collection.

SortCode.description: The six-digit code used to identify a UK bank branch.

SpecificSymbol.description: An additional payment identifier used in supported Czech and Slovak payment schemes.

Swift.description: The SWIFT/BIC identifier used to route international payments.

VariableSymbol.description: The primary payment identifier used in supported Czech and Slovak payment schemes.

VoCode.description: The payment classification code used in supported countries.

TemporaryCardToken.description: The temporary token representing the recipient's payment card.

UrgentPaymentTypeId.description: Identifies the urgent payment type used to process the payment.

FundingAccountId.description: Identifies the funding account from which this portion of the transaction amount is drawn.

IsLead.description: Indicates whether the funding account is the lead account. The lead account receives any amount remaining after split values are rounded.

CardDetails.description: Card details used for card payment processing.

Last4Digits.description: The last four digits of the card.

UserToken.description: The token representing the card user.

AccountNumber.description: The bank account number to check.

Iban.description: The International Bank Account Number (IBAN) to check.

SortCode.description: The six-digit UK sort code to check.

ConfirmationOfPayeeResponse.description:
Result returned from a Confirmation of Payee check.

| ReasonCode | Description |
| ---- | ------- |
| ANNM | The account name does not match |
| MBAM | The account name may match (close match) |
| BANM | The account name matches a business account |
| PANM | The account name matches a personal account |
| BAMM | The account name may match a business account |
| PAMM | The account name may match a personal account |
| AC01 | The account number was incorrect or could not be found |
| IVCR | The customer reference is invalid |
| ACNS | The account type is not supported by Confirmation of Payee |
| OPTO | The account holder has opted out of Confirmation of Payee checks |
| CASS | The account has been switched to a different bank through the Current Account Switch Service |
| SCNS | The receiving bank does not support Confirmation of Payee checks |

AccountName.description: The account name returned by the check.

CorrelationId.description: Identifies the Confirmation of Payee check.

Matched.description: Indicates whether the account details matched.

ReasonCode.description: The reason code returned by the Confirmation of Payee check.

SuggestedText.description: Suggested explanatory text returned by the Confirmation of Payee check.

TimestampUTC.description: When the event occurred, in UTC.

ExchangeRate.description: The exchange rate used for the transaction.

ValueDate.description: The date on which the payment is expected to reach the recipient.

MailClass.description: The postal service used to send the cheque. Some delivery services may require prior enablement and commercial agreement. For available delivery options, tracking information, and estimated delivery times, see [Cheque delivery and settlement](doc:cheque-delivery-and-settlement).

TrackingNumber.description: The tracking number assigned to the postal cheque delivery.

Currency.description: The currency, in ISO 4217 currency code format.

Value.description: The amount in the specified currency.
